preconditions.description: The number of cities N is between 2 and 200 inclusive.
The number of roads M is between 1 and 50000 inclusive.
The cost of one gold coin G is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The cost of one silver coin S is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= N and 1 <= yi <= N for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects cities with numbers between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= gi <= 10**9 and 1 <= si <= 10**9 for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road's gold and silver requirements gi and si are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'impossible' or a non-negative integer representing the minimal cost in tugriks.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'impossible' or all(gi <= a and si <= b for xi, yi, gi, si in roads for a, b in [(return_value // G, return_value % G // S)])
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'impossible', it is the minimal cost such that for any road, the gift contains at least gi gold and si silver coins.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'impossible' or all(connected(x, y) for x in range(1, N+1) for y in range(1, N+1))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'impossible', there exists a safe path between any two cities with the given gift.
